Author: mole99
Content:
As far as I'm aware, these devices are available on gf180mcuD with the mask set used by wafer.space.
They are just very special-purpose built mosfets (comp does not fully connect D/S).

However, if anyone is planning on using them for Run 3, please make sure to test them sooner rather than later. I might need to fix a few things in the KLayout DRC deck for them to pass precheck. For example, see: https://github.com/fossi-foundation/globalfoundries-pdk-libs-gf180mcu_fd_pr/issues/50

Author: mole99
Content: I created those with the KLayout-native PCells. Use with caution.

Author: mole99
Content: They do use `MVSD`/`MVPSD`, but from what I can see, those are not physical layers/extra mask layers.

Content: I thought this was what `MVNVT` mask was for.

Author: mole99
Content: I think you're right! However, looking at my docs, we did have `1L` in the Run1/Run2 mask set, and it's also in Run3. It's part of the "always included masks". It's strange, though, that they did not list `n/pfet_10v0_asym` as a possible device in that configuration.

Content: So, to me, it seems like we should give it a try.
